items.summary: A USD120 billion framework agreement to build six Westinghouse AP1000 units and two of South Korea's APR1400 units in the USA has been outlined by the US Department of Commerce.

items.title: Constellation, Amazon agree nuclear-focused power purchase deal
items.summary: A 20-year power purchase agreement signed by tech giant Amazon will enable Constellation to add 190 MW of capacity and extend the operating life of the Calvert Cliffs nuclear power plant in Maryland in the US.

items.summary: Scaling-up nuclear capacity remains one of the major challenges for the global nuclear industry, and Polina Lion, chief sustainability officer of Russia's state nuclear corporation Rosatom, outlined four priority areas for action at World Nuclear Symposium in London.
